text.Stellar Reef:
Stellar reef Stellar Reef.jpg Colony Wars Blob Base 3 defense 2 2 1 3 
 How to Play ==
When you play Stellar Reef you gain 1 trade. Any time during your turn you can scrap the Stellar Reef to gain 3 Combat.
 Strategy ==
Flymsy base with meager stats. Cheap with a cost of only 2 Trade. Big advantage is that you can scrap this base for 3 Combat. Later in the game to meager to make a difference.
